summary: DAT-002: grant operations wrote multiple JSON files in sequence (grantEntitlement: receipts then entitlements; approveClaim: grant then claim-status flip; passRedeem: credit debit then grant; bundleTestPurchase: N grants then orders insert; signup: account then session). A crash between the writes left divergent state. Added a write-ahead journal to lib/store.js: txnBegin/txnInsert/txnUpdate stage writes in memory; txnCommit fsyncs the full write set to .journal.jsonl first, applies each write (atomic tmp+rename per file), then fsyncs a commit marker. reconcileOnBoot() — called before the server listens — re-applies every staged-but-uncommitted txn idempotently (insert-if-absent by id field, update-if-present), then compacts the journal. All five sequences now commit as single atomic units; a crash at any point converges to all-or-nothing on the next boot.
